claims.quote: The heavy oak door's deadbolt had been slid from the inside.
The sash window was latched; the sill showed a faint dusting of garden pollen.
Her hand still clutched an engraved pocket watch; its hands had stopped at 9:07, and the case bore a hairline puncture and a faint film of oil.

Her hand still clutched an engraved pocket watch; its hands had stopped at 9:07, and the case bore a hairline puncture and a faint film of oil.
A small folded scrap of paper was clenched in her fingers, sealed with a trace of red sealing-wax.
On the desk a crystal ashtray held three short, rough-ended butts of a coarse tobacco I did not recognise from the household's usual brand.
Near the mantel I found a small flake of red sealing-wax.
There was the smell of machine oil about the hearth—sharp and metallic in the air, like a lathe left running and then abandoned.
Henry Crane standing as if he were a model of restraint
Marta planted like a hinge beside the desk
Derek from next door lingering in the hall with the careful stillness of a man who watches mechanisms
Inspector Rao keeping to the edge with his notebook closed but ready.
I made notes. Photographing and cataloguing are someone else's ordinance; deduction is mine.

promises.promise: The two-line cipher on the scrap in Evelyn's hand will be transcribed for later analysis.
promises.quote: The scrap bore a two-line cipher; I had not been given a transcription of its exact letters.
